svg.title: Where a view starts, archived contractor
svg.text: Where a view starts, archived contractor

g.text: The open menu covers the notice's Restore button at every size, as the menu does in the app today. On a phone it also covers the end of the line.
Scale: 1280 and 768 frames at 0.5, 375 at 0.75. The 1280 frame is drawn 960 tall to reach the Portal access card.
